title: Piper, high quality

tricks: Speed 1.07 gives a length scale of about 0.93, a little brisker than the default
Noise scale and rhythm variation are raised for a livelier delivery
Pause is written as an ellipsis, which Piper treats as a sentence break
Um is written out as a word

why: Piper's larger model for the same single female voice, with its speed and variation knobs nudged for a livelier read, and no way to make any sound but speech.
